scopeNote: Georgia's 6th Congressional District (GA-06). NOTE: This seat is held by Democrat Lucy McBath (D), NOT Republican Rich McCormick. McCormick represents GA-07. GA-06 was redrawn after 2023 court-ordered redistricting into a D+25 safe-Democratic seat covering portions of Cobb, Fulton, Douglas, and Fayette counties.

contests.incumbentStatus: McBath suspended a gubernatorial bid March 2025 and stated she is remaining in Congress. Has NOT formally filed for 2026 reelection as of 2026-02-25. Filing deadline March 6.
contests.raceContext: Safe Democratic seat. McBath won 74.7% in 2024. Small field — McBath likely running but not yet filed. Sonya Halpern (State Senator) originally filed conditionally on McBath running for governor.

candidates.notes: Four-term Congresswoman. Gun violence prevention advocate; mother of Jordan Davis. Won 2024 with 74.7%. Not yet formally filed for 2026 but active legislatively (introduced H.R.7599 Feb 2026).

Georgia State Senator (District 39, since 2021). Former marketing executive. Filed FEC Statement of Candidacy. Originally conditional on McBath running for governor, but remains listed as active candidate.
Also registered as Independent U.S. Senate candidate. Minimal public presence.
Sole declared Republican. D+25 district makes GOP general election prospects minimal.
